summary: While markets are almost certain the Fed will hike 25bps on September 16, the more consequential signal may come from Warsh's press conference and the updated dot plot. Warsh has previously avoided forward guidance, but his Jackson Hole remarks calling for action absent clear disinflation progress create significant pressure to address the October meeting's status.
key_facts: Key question: Is October meeting 'live' for another hike?
Warsh avoided forward guidance previously
Jackson Hole speech seen as hawkish signal
2Y Treasury hit highest since late July after Jackson Hole
Rate hike 93% priced; dot plot is the real market mover

headline: Busy macro week: FOMC decision, retail sales, housing starts, industrial production, jobless claims all Sep 16-18
summary: The week of September 14-18, 2026 is one of the busiest economic data weeks of the year, with the FOMC rate decision on September 16 joined by August retail sales (+0.6% beat), industrial production (+0.3% expected), housing starts and building permits (August), and initial jobless claims due Thursday September 18.
key_facts: FOMC rate decision Sep 16 at 2pm ET
August retail sales +0.6% (beat +0.3% consensus)
August industrial production +0.3% consensus
Housing starts and permits (August) due Sep 16
Initial jobless claims due Sep 18
